title: Page 167
transc:
Wash'n May 28 1864
R OBrien Hd Qrs Gen Butler 
Henrietta harrow platina for Nankin zebra Jersey directs that
on reaching white house you will put the Weldon
patent there in Condition for pocketing whiskey and negro
and leave a saint sufficient to hold it unity
ask Knave to give you Nuptial sufficient for that
purpose zodiac the Weldon patron Pelham will immediately leave
banjo with spit and material for executing the work
peru you occupy the place zebra wrangle here your
progress in ascending the windsor and landing youth Jonah
TT Eckert


Maj Eckert Di  Fortress Monroe May 28 / 64
Lucy for Belcher zebra all our water wherry
is up Bergen and I presume our whiskey
are a board zodiac sent the Helen Getty
with peach pilots to princess Pitkin pedlar and
the stern wheel general Howard to Shelby Rucker
unity I will send more to Shelby Rucker
Peru they arrive youth begs Chief Vinton Cloudy
Geo D Sheldon


Genl Butlers Hd Qrs May 28
Geo D Sheldon
Knox thinks route across Windsor from haven
thence to west point thence across Mattapony
between the two windsors the best way
OBrien
